title: Compile the exact coefficient and a rejected factor on supplied rational states
statement: The acquired reviewed exact compiler checks rational Hermitian density matrices, obtains private projectors without a numerical rank threshold, and verifies both complex extraction families. On the SAME0,+source it reports r=1/2, factor2and16extraction entries. For rejected factor3/2it returns a=1/4,b=1,h=5,k=31and the exact dyadic prior; no matrix-log/root/solver/reference queries. The reported.00405safter-import execution is one real binary source, not another run or arbitrary mixed-state performance claim. Large k/output precision and physical state preparation remain paid.

assumptions: Exact supplied finite density matrices, n>=2 CLASSICALlabels and exact supports are essential. B independently reconstructed the whole corrected root proof; C also whole-reviewed while disclosing prior contribution, not a blind review. The actual source-first Choi vector is vec(conjugate Z). Arbitrarily small full-rank contamination gives r=0, so the universal reverse factor is not robust under unrestricted channel uncertainty. The extraction effects are not a jointly normalized physical POVM. No arbitrary pairwise CQnecessity, channel acquisition, privacy/capacity, unchanged multi-use factor, physical inverse, practical advantage or priority is acquired.
